scodex-mini: A Minimal Codex Written in SLA

scodex-mini is the smallest runnable Codex unit written in SLA: a single-turn agent CLI whose behavior matches the Rust version codex-min. Its significance is that it proves the SLA toolchain can already write a real, networked, stateful agent program with a tool-calling loop — a prompt goes in, it POSTs to the model API, prints text, executes shell_exec tool calls, and loops until the model wraps up (at most 8 turns). The source is in ~/workspace/scodex-mini (the standalone repository layola13/codexmini).

Running Form

export PATH="$HOME/.sa/bin:$PATH" SA_STD_DIR="$HOME/.sa/std" SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1

# 新会话：每轮落库
OPENAI_API_KEY=... ./scodex-mini "帮我看看这个目录"

# 列出会话（不需要 API key）
./scodex-mini --list
#   session id=1 msgs=4 updated_ms=1789744779005

# 带着后续问题恢复会话 1
OPENAI_API_KEY=... ./scodex-mini --resume 1 "继续"

Dual API Modes

Environment variableAPIDescription
Not set (default)Responses API/v1/responses; function_call / function_call_output are paired by call_id
SCODEX_API_MODE=chatChat Completions API/v1/chat/completions; tool calls are routed by index

Both modes go through the same SSE and retry entry points (see below).

SSE Streaming Output

Requests carry stream:true and complete one streaming turn through the http-client plugin's native high-level API sa_http_client_sse_turn:

  • Text deltas are output to stdout in real time; tool-call fragments (argument shards) are reassembled routed by call_id (Responses) or index (Chat), supporting multiple tools in parallel / out-of-order fragments;
  • Return values: 0 = text complete, 1 = there is a tool call (after local execution, a second-round request is issued), 2 = error;
  • Retries apply only to the initial POST (429/5xx/transient network errors, at most 5 attempts, exponential backoff of 1/2/4/8/16 seconds, respecting a Retry-After cap of 5 minutes); once the stream has started there are no more retries.

Session Persistence

Sessions are stored via sa_plugin_db (not SQLite) in $HOME/.scodex-mini/db, in two tables: sessions(id, created_ms, updated_ms, msg_count, title_blob) and messages(session_id, seq, role, body_blob). Role encoding: 0=user, 1=assistant, 2=function_call ({"call_id","name","args"}), 3=function_call_output ({"call_id","output"}). --resume replays history by seq; a corrupted tool-call record produces an explicit error and aborts, rather than silently dropping history.

Multimodal and File Input

  • Image understanding: a local image path is passed to the model as input (image view);
  • File/document/image path input: the contents of a local file are passed to the model as context;
  • Skills and MCP: --mcp supports tools from external MCP servers.

Source Layout

packages/codex-mini/src/
  config.sla      OPENAI_API_KEY 与 SCODEX_API_MODE 配置
  protocol.sla    MiniEventKind / MiniToolCall / MiniTurnOutcome
  http.sla        sa_http_client.sai 适配 + HTTPS POST
  model.sla       双 API 请求构建/响应解析/turn 循环/会话 DB
  tools.sla       shell_exec：sh -c 执行并捕获 stdout
  main.sla        CLI：argv → prompt / --list / --resume
  sessionx.sa     会话 DB 宏（DB 路径、行编码）

Build: sa sla build-exe --release-fast -o scodex-mini; the artifact is about 1.1MB. For local integration testing you can use e2e/mock_responses.py (a pure-HTTP Responses API mock listening on 127.0.0.1:8080) to get the tool loop working first, then switch to a real key.

NoteThe network layer uses the http-client plugin's curl child-process approach (the most stable for proxy + TLS; see the http-client plugin page); Accept-Encoding: identity is always sent, and if a server forces compression that needs separate handling.

Sources: the scodex-mini repository README.md (2026-09-19 edition), sa_http_client.sai, and the sa_http_client_sse_turn comments in the http-client plugin's src/http_saasm_api.zig.
